I know it can be frustrating sometimes getting through on the phone but at 8am when it opens, there is already a queue lining up outside & about 50 people trying to get through on the phone & only a limited number of staff dealing with this onslaught. I’ve been told occasionally that they have no appointment left on that day but I’ve never had to try for more than 2 days before I get an appointment.  This is the same in every GP Practice that isn’t a Private Practice.

I’ve never had a rude Receptionist either, some are more smiley than others but everyone has always been Professional.

The Dr’s themselves have always been very generous with their time & I’ve always left the room feeling valued. I am sad to hear that Dr Blake has now left, she was wonderful, she worked so hard for me to get support with my medical issues & I can’t thank her enough for all of her advice & patience, whichever Practice she has gone to are very lucky.

There could be a little more innovation by bringing other services in house but I don’t know the logistics of that but it should be explored.

Overall, from my experience over many years being with this Practice - I would recommend it without
